section.title: Overview
section.para: An application that uses the built-in OpenNLP components and loads its models from files or streams can be compiled into a GraalVM native image. Core registers its tool factories, serializers, feature generators, trainers and model loaders through ExtensionRegistrar services, so loading a model needs no reflection. This add-on supplies the rest: reachability metadata for the bundled resources that core reads by a name computed at run time, such as the stopword list of a language. Add org.apache.opennlp.addons:native-image as a dependency and the image builder picks the metadata up from the jar.

This covers opennlp-api, opennlp-runtime, the opennlp-ml-* modules, opennlp-model-resolver and opennlp-formats. ReachabilityMetadataTest fails when the runtime jar bundles a resource that no glob covers.

section.title: Building an image
section.para: Build the image with the GraalVM Maven plugin or with native-image directly, on a GraalVM JDK 25 or later. Load models from files or streams:

NativeSmoke in this add-on is a minimal native application. It loads the sentence detector, tokenizer, POS tagger and person name finder models from a directory and checks each result. The native profile builds and runs it:

listitem.para: Class path scanning for models is not available in an image. The simple finder logs a warning and returns an empty result. Load models from files or streams.
Java serialization of models is not supported in an image; use the model's own serialize(OutputStream) and InputStream constructor.
opennlp-dl, the ONNX Runtime and opennlp-cli are out of scope.
A custom extension named in a model must be registered through an ExtensionRegistrar, because the image has no reflection metadata for it. See the extension chapter of the OpenNLP manual.
